title: Amcor Packaging (Australia) Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of the plant at Smithfield NSW owned by Carter Holt Harvey Packaging
targets: the plant at Smithfield NSW owned by Carter Holt Harvey Packaging

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Amcor Packaging (Australia) Pty Ltd proposes to acquire the folding carton plant at Smithfield NSW, owned by Carter Holt Harvey Packaging Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of the national market for the manufacture and supply of folding cartons.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. In forming this view the ACCC had regard to the following factors: - that post acquisition, a number of other substantial suppliers of folding cartons will remain in the relevant market, thereby constraining the merged entity's ability to increase product prices or reduce service quality; - that larger customers of folding cartons were found to have countervailing power; and - that customer switching costs were not high.
